description: Send a pending team invitation again when its delivery was not confirmed. An invitation already queued for delivery is refused, and invitations to one address are limited each hour. No seat changes. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can resend, while the plan includes team seats.

member_id.description: The teammate's seat id, from list_team_members.

name: resend_team_invitation

delivery.description: sent: the invitation is queued for delivery. unverified: delivery could not be confirmed, so the invitation may not arrive; resend_team_invitation can try again.

title: Resend a team invitation
